answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 32% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the juniper forfeiture exposes up in the basalt totals with the shale audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 295 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
